The '''Wolf-Head Banner''' is the banner given to [[Perrin Aybara]] after he saves the [[Two Rivers]] from an onslaught of Trollocks. Following the battles many call Perrin Aybara the Lord of the Two Rivers and erect the Wolf-Head Banner for him. Perrin many times protests the banner and orders it taken down but in the end he accepts the Banner.
